name: s2-resp-feature
config:
[[permissions]]
tool = "apply_patch"
pattern = "*"
decision = "allow"
[[permissions]]
tool = "run_command"
pattern = "python -m pytest*"
decision = "allow"

args: Add `mad(values)` to tools/stats.py: the median absolute deviation of the values, skipping missing values the same way the other helpers in that module do, and returning None when nothing is left. Add tests for it next to the existing stats tests, and run the stats tests.
